meta.title: nPanel System Architecture
meta.subtitle: Beginner guide — how the landing page, dashboard, API, data stores, and background jobs fit together

boundaries.label: 1 · Websites people open in a browser
2 · Backend on Google Cloud Run (login wall)
3 · Private data (not reachable from the browser)

cards.title: Start here — the three websites
items: Landing Page (apps/www.nisccloud.com): public site for marketing, pricing, domain search, cart, and checkout
nPanel Dashboard (apps/web): the signed-in control panel for agencies and customers (hosting, billing, creatives, ads…)
Docs Site (apps/fumadocs): help articles only — it does not call the API
Both the Landing Page and Dashboard talk to the API through a same-origin /api proxy so login cookies stay safe

cards.title: What the API Server does
items: Built with Hono + tRPC in apps/server (packages/api holds the business logic)
Main doors: /api/auth (login), /api/trpc (app features), /api/uploadthing (files), /api/webhooks/* (partner callbacks)
Feature areas include hosting (Plesk/Hivelocity), domains, billing, teams, creatives/AI, email marketing, ads, and tax (eTIMS)
Can run as role=api (user traffic) or role=workers (background jobs) on Google Cloud Run

cards.title: Login wall (who is allowed in)
items: People never talk to the database directly — only through the API after login checks
Dashboard users: Better Auth cookie sessions stored in PostgreSQL, cached in Redis, with MFA email OTP when needed
Machines/integrations: API keys that start with npanel_sk_* (stored hashed)
Background workers ignore user cookies — they only accept cryptographically signed QStash requests

cards.title: Where data lives
items: PostgreSQL (+ PgBouncer): the real source of truth for users, orders, hosting, invoices, and more (Drizzle ORM in packages/db)
Redis (Upstash): optional fast cache for sessions, rate limits, and short-lived tokens — if Redis is down, the app falls back to Postgres
File Storage (MinIO/S3 + UploadThing): images, uploads, and generated creative assets
Job Queue (QStash): holds slow work (send campaigns, provision orders, run AI jobs) until workers finish it

cards.title: Partner services (outside our cloud)
items: Payments: M-Pesa STK Push  ·  Hosting: Plesk, Hivelocity, JetBackup  ·  Domains: OpenProvider, KENIC (.ke)
Email: AWS SES (and some legacy Resend)  ·  AI: Replicate, Stability AI  ·  Ads: Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Ads
Tax: KRA eTIMS / DigiTax  ·  SEO: Google PageSpeed
Partners call back through signed webhooks (M-Pesa, Replicate, SES/SNS) — never trusted blindly

cards.title: Simple story of one request
items: 1) You open the Landing Page or nPanel Dashboard in your browser
2) The site forwards /api calls to the API Server (same-origin proxy)
3) Login & Security checks your session (Redis first, PostgreSQL if cache miss)
4) The API reads/writes PostgreSQL, may store files, or enqueues a background job
5) Workers finish slow tasks and update the database; the UI shows the result
